title: Pac Gal gameplay (PC Game, 1982)
source_description: Played through Dosbox emulation platform. Recorded with original sound.
finding: The empty-cell 150 Hz effects can last tens of ms; resetting each note to nominal 3*2048 PIT clocks misses the already scheduled slow IRQ0.
runtime_evidence: Original runtime 1F53..1F5A writes 2048 to port 40 without a new control word; 1B88..1BA4 disables speaker and restores count 65536.
change: Keep pending IRQ0 across count changes; later sound ticks at divisor 2048, idle ticks at 65536. Default audio uses a 3 Hz first-order DC blocker fitted approximately to this recording, LP4300 retained. Original HP120 small-speaker profile remains available for tests.
limitations: Recording uses DOSBox and lossy YouTube Opus, not a physical IBM measurement. Response profile is approximate; no claim of sample-exact agreement with the video.
tests: 44.1/48 kHz pending first IRQ at 2048 and 65536 clocks, duration bound, phase reload, callback invariance, effects/maze regressions pass.
